summary: In the executive meeting held on April 22, 2023, participants discussed the upcoming product launch, confirming a beta rollout on April 28 and a public launch in May. Bob shared insights from the Celtics game, while the team addressed engineering needs, legal review timelines, and potential API rate limits. Action items were assigned, including the preparation of a feature flag and rollout checklist by Friday, and the final marketing landing page to be delivered to Alice by Thursday noon. The team agreed to revisit budget discussions after Q2 projections and will finalize the podcast promotion details in the next standup.
